# Skills

Every install receives the shared AI Guy operating skill, the go-to-market role
skill, Hermes's bundled skills, and the repository's Instantly prospecting,
campaign, and deliverability skills. The installer tracks hashes so official
updates replace only unchanged managed files; customer-edited skills are
preserved.

Hermes discovers skills in the profile's skills directory. A new skill must have
a narrow purpose, explicit trigger, required inputs, output contract, permission
boundary, and verification step. Install it disabled or read-only first when it
can write to an external system.

The current Hermes skill catalog and format are documented at
<https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/skills>. Never paste a skill from an
untrusted source directly into a live agent. Review its scripts, network calls,
dependencies, credential access, and destructive actions first.
